title: 第十二章  小巷
content_zh:
黑衣少女走向小巷深处，偶尔会有人家挂出喜庆的大红灯笼，相比其他人，帷帽少女没有什么家族的精心铺垫，没有什么草蛇灰线伏延千里，她就这么孑然一身，闯入小镇。
小巷不远处，站着一个锦衣少年，双手正高高捧起一方青色玉玺，稚童的巴掌大小，雕刻有龙盘虎踞，在阳光的照射下，熠熠生辉，玉玺内隐约有丝丝缕缕的霞光亮起。锦衣少年抬头眯眼望着手中这方至宝，满脸陶醉。
在他身边，有个高大老人单膝跪地，正在用袖口仔细擦拭少年靴子上的泥土。
锦衣少年的眼角余光，其实也早早发现了奇怪少女，头戴浅露款式的帷帽，悬佩一柄绿鞘狭刀，步伐沉稳，显而易见，她绝不会是小镇本地人。
只不过锦衣少年毫不在意，仍然仔细端详着那方沉寂千年的古老玉玺，内心深处，他甚至希望那少女心生夺宝念头，要不然实在是太无趣了。
反正他已经两样东西得手，收获之丰，远超预想，如果再不找点事情做做，他就只能带着老奴就此离去，对于这位少年而言，会觉得缺少点什么。
就好比他在小镇万里以外的那个家里，身上穿着一袭金黄色的九蟒大袍子，只可惜，始终少了一爪。
来此小镇，每位选定之人，可携带三枚信物，分别装入锦囊绣袋，之前交给看门人一只袋子，属于必须掏出来的过路费，不管那个看门人身份高低，不论城门如何破烂不堪，即便是一国君主，或者一宗祖师来此，也得老老实实按照这个规矩来。其余两只锦囊绣袋，意思是在此最多捞取两件宝物带出小镇，否则任你在这里搜刮到十件、百件宝贝，也要一一还回去。袋子里的信物，是三种形制特殊的铜钱，分别是市井百姓用以庆贺上梁的压胜钱，皇宫每年悬挂于桃符上的迎春钱，以及被城隍爷塑像托在掌心的供养钱，说是铜钱，其实质地是珍稀异常的金精，对于“山下”大多数凡夫俗子而言，连官家纹银都不常见，更何况是一袋子沉甸甸的“黄金”，确实足以让人心甘情愿来兜售传家宝。
锦衣少年对于三种不见于正史记载的铜钱，钻研了一路，也琢磨不出任何门道。
前方，浑身散发出一种冷峻气息的少女，笔直前行，将小巷主仆二人视若无物。
锦衣少年临时改变主意，收起了那方玉玺，装入一只早就准备好的布袋子，系挂在腰间，但是依然站在小巷中央，没有要让路的意思。
身材高大、皮肤白皙的老人也站起身，嗓音阴柔，细声细气道：：“殿下，此人是个登堂入室的练家子，不可掉以轻心。若是在小镇以外，自然不用在意。可是在此地，便是咱家这副走纯粹武道的体魄，也时时刻刻承受此方世界的压制，极为难受。一旦全力运转气息、窍穴大开，就会像是江海倒灌，经脉窍穴都会洪水泛滥，一发不可收拾，到时候咱家死了事小，殿下安危事大啊。如果由于咱家的照顾不周，使得殿下修道的千秋大业，出现丁点儿纰漏，回去之后，咱家如何跟陛下和娘娘交待？”
锦衣少年促狭道：“吴爷爷，你出宫之后，话变得多了。以前在宫里头，你一年到头就是翻来倒去那几句话，比我姐饲养的那只笨鹦鹉还不如。”
老人自称“咱家”，处处骨子里透着卑躬屈膝，尤其是在心底以此为豪，只能是忠心耿耿的宫中阉人。
他见这位小主人好像没有听明白自己的言下之意，只得更加直白说道：“殿下，小巷此人在此地，已经有可能对殿下造成威胁。”
锦衣少年懒洋洋笑道：“虽然我早就听闻修行路上，三教九流鱼龙混杂，许多邪门歪道，更多旁门左道，但是我和她不过一场萍水相逢，她这就要见财起意，杀人夺宝？不太可能吧？要是‘山上’人人如此，岂不是早就天下大乱了？”
老人叹了口气，山下王朝和山上仙家，双方貌合神离，其实是相看两相厌的立场。
锦衣少年有些心灰意冷，“算啦算啦，把这笔烂账算在一个丫头头上，不算大丈夫所为。”
少女走到他身前，左手按住刀柄。
锦衣少年笑了笑，侧过身，示意少女先行。

黑衣少女也稍稍放缓脚步，微微侧身，帷帽后的眼神，充满戒备警惕。
当年迈宦官发现少女用棉布包扎的受伤双手，忍不住眉头紧皱。
“放肆！”
骤然间老人一声怒喝，如舌绽春雷，双脚好似一滑，高大身影便来到锦衣少年身前，老人后背轻轻一靠，以巧劲将少年推在小巷墙壁上，同时左手张开五指。
手心处传来一记沉闷的撞击声。
原来是有人以石子作为暗器，砸向锦衣少年的头颅侧面。
声势惊人，力道几乎足以贯穿一堵墙壁。
老人砰然捏碎手心拳头大小的石子，却不是杀向那名刺客，而是右手一拳轰向那个黑衣少女。
悬刀少女略作犹豫，强行压抑下拔刀出鞘的本能，而是歪过脑袋，刚好躲过这势大力沉的刚猛一拳。
拳风之烈，瞬间吹乱少女的帷帽薄纱。
高大老人变直拳为横扫，拳头正好砸向少女的脑袋。
拳势圆转如意，毫无凝滞。
少女只得迅速抬起双臂，双手手背叠放在一起，护在耳畔之外，呈现出十字交错的防御姿态，挡在拳路前方。
下一刻，少女整个人侧滑出去十数步。
少女轻轻吐出一口浊气，伸出手心鲜血渗透棉布更多的那只手，扶正了头顶有些歪斜的帷帽。
她有些生气。
少女转过身，望着那个左右张望了一下的高大老人，一板一眼说道：“如果不是我，就已经是个死人了。”
老人置若罔闻，只是相较之前，这位对于刺杀偷袭可谓经验丰富的老宦官，已经将少女的危害程度，下降为第二位，第一把交椅，则让位给了小巷另一侧的出手之人。
当然，小巷除了主仆二人，真正的外人，也就只有两个。
小巷那边，站着个高高瘦瘦的蒙面人。

手臂却极其粗壮，隆起肌肉如铁球。
他腰间悬挂两只袋子，装着满满当当的圆状物体。
他就站在原地，好像在说，之前的偷袭，其实只是提醒罢了。
阴冷的视线，掠过少女身上的时候。
男人咧了咧嘴角，吐了吐舌头，眼神炙热。
少女呵呵一笑，说了两个字。
“回来！”
话音刚落。
一剑过头颅。
飞剑来到少女身边，环绕她急速旋转，如稚童撒娇。
她没好气道：“滚！”
飞剑一闪而逝。
主仆二人，呆若木鸡。
年老宦官并非震惊于这一手飞剑术的本身。
而是对于少女能够在此地随意驾驭飞剑，而感到由衷的恐惧。
这种感觉，让老人恍惚之间，像是回到了少年时代，初次入宫，战战兢兢，某天遥遥看着那位身穿大红蟒服、行走于宫墙下的前辈。
当然不是敬畏那个连名字都不知道的宦官本人，而是害怕那一抹刺眼的猩红。
锦衣少年回过神后，笑了笑，充满自嘲，向前走出一步，关心问道：“吴爷爷，没事吧？”
白发苍苍的老宦官脸色沉重，摇头道：“小心为妙。实在不行，咱家就……”
少年赶紧摆手，问道：“要不然咱们道个歉？”

老人有些措手不及，继而悲愤和自责。
主辱臣死。
尤其是帝王人家！
但是锦衣少年已经笑道：“吴爷爷，做了错事，说句对不起，有什么难的。”
老人仍是觉得此举不妥，锦衣少年已经向少女走去。
刹那之间，老人百感交集。
原来少年的后背并无半点泥屑。
content_en:
The girl in black walked towards the depths of the alley, where occasionally someone would hang out a festive red lantern. Compared to the others, the girl in the curtain hat did not have the careful preparation of the family, and there was no grass snake and gray thread stretching thousands of miles. She just broke into the town alone.
Not far from the alley, stood a young man in brocade clothes. He was holding up a blue jade seal with both hands. It was the size of a child's palm and was engraved with a dragon and a tiger crouching. Under the sunlight, it shone brightly. There were faint rays of rays of light inside the jade seal. The young man in brocade clothes raised his head and squinted at the treasure in his hand, his face full of intoxication.
Beside him, there was a tall old man kneeling on one knee, carefully wiping the mud from the boy's boots with his cuffs.
Out of the corner of his eye, the young man in brocade clothes actually spotted a strange girl early on. She was wearing a revealing hat and a narrow green sheath knife. She was walking calmly. It was obvious that she was definitely not a local from the town.
However, the young man in brocade clothes didn't care and still carefully looked at the ancient jade seal that had been silent for thousands of years. Deep in his heart, he even hoped that the girl would have the idea of ​​seizing the treasure, otherwise it would be too boring.
Anyway, he has obtained two things, and the harvest is far greater than expected. If he doesn't find something to do, he will have no choice but to take the old slave and leave. For this young man, he will feel that something is missing.
Just like when he was at home thousands of miles away in a small town, he was wearing a golden nine-python robe, but unfortunately, one claw was missing.
When coming to this town, each selected person can bring three tokens, which are put into brocade bags respectively. The bag given to the gatekeeper is a toll that must be paid out. No matter the status of the gatekeeper, no matter how dilapidated the city gate is, even if he is a monarch of a country or a founder of a sect, he must follow this rule honestly. The remaining two treasures and embroidered bags mean that you can pick up at most two treasures here and take them out of the town. Otherwise, if you find ten or hundreds of treasures here, you have to return them one by one. The tokens in the bag are three kinds of copper coins with special shapes. They are the winning coins used by the people in the market to celebrate Liang Liang, the Spring Festival coins hung on peach symbols in the palace every year, and the offering coins held in the palm of the hand by the statue of the City God. They are said to be copper coins. , in fact, the texture is extremely rare gold essence. For most ordinary people "under the mountain", even official silver patterns are not common, let alone a heavy bag of "gold", which is indeed enough to make people willing to sell family heirlooms.
The young man in Jinyi studied all the way about three kinds of copper coins that were not recorded in official history, but he couldn't figure out any way.
Ahead, a girl exuding a cold aura walked straight forward, ignoring the master and servant in the alley.
The young man in brocade suddenly changed his mind, put away the square jade seal, put it into a cloth bag that had been prepared long ago, and hung it around his waist. However, he still stood in the middle of the alley with no intention of giving way.
The tall, fair-skinned old man also stood up and said softly in a soft voice: "Your Highness, this person is a practicing practitioner who has entered the palace and cannot be taken lightly. If he is outside a small town, naturally he doesn't need to care. But here, even our family's pure martial arts physiques are always under the oppression of this world, which is extremely uncomfortable. Once the breath is fully activated and the acupoints are opened, it will be like a river and the sea will flood, and the meridians and acupoints will flood out of control. It will be a small matter if our family dies, but the safety of His Highness will be a big deal. If due to our family's poor care, there is a slight flaw in His Majesty's great cause of Taoism, how will our family explain to Your Majesty and the Queen after we return? "
The young man in brocade clothes said nervously: "Grandpa Wu, after you left the palace, you talked a lot. In the palace before, you just recited a few words all year round, which was worse than the stupid parrot my sister raised."
The old man calls himself "our family", and he is groveling in every aspect, especially in the bottom of his heart he is proud of it., can only be a loyal eunuch in the palace.
Seeing that the young master didn't seem to understand what he meant, he had to say more bluntly: "Your Highness, this person in the alley is here and may pose a threat to Your Highness."
The boy in golden clothes smiled lazily and said: "Although I have long heard that on the road of cultivation, there are many evils and evils from the three religions and nine streams, many evil ways, and even more heretical ways, but she and I just met by chance, and now she wants to get rich and kill people to seize treasures? It's not possible, right? If everyone on the mountain is like this, wouldn't it be possible that the world would be in chaos already?"
The old man sighed. The dynasty at the foot of the mountain and the fairy family on the mountain seemed to be inseparable from each other, but they actually looked at each other and hated each other.
The young man in brocade clothes was a little disheartened, "Forget it, forget it, blaming this bad debt on a girl is not something a man has done."
The girl walked up to him and held the handle of the knife with her left hand.
The young man in brocade clothes smiled, turned sideways, and motioned for the girl to go first.
The girl in black also slowed down slightly and turned slightly sideways. Her eyes behind the curtain were full of vigilance.
When the old eunuch found the girl's injured hands wrapped in cotton, he couldn't help but frown.
"Presumptuous!"
Suddenly, the old man shouted angrily, like spring thunder on his tongue, his feet seemed to slip, and the tall figure came in front of the young man in brocade. The old man leaned his back gently and pushed the young man against the alley wall with skillful force. At the same time, he spread the fingers of his left hand.
There was a dull thud in the palm of his hand.
It turned out that someone used a stone as a hidden weapon and hit the side of the Jinyi boy's head.
The sound was astonishing, almost powerful enough to penetrate a wall.
The old man smashed a stone the size of his fist in the palm of his hand, but instead of attacking the assassin, he punched the girl in black with his right hand.
The girl with the hanging sword hesitated for a moment, suppressing the instinct to draw the sword out of its sheath. Instead, she tilted her head, just in time to avoid the powerful and heavy punch.
The force of the fist blow instantly ruffled the girl's veil.
The tall old man changed his straight fist into a sweeping blow, and his fist hit the girl's head.
The fist moves smoothly and smoothly, without any stagnation.
The girl had no choice but to quickly raise her arms, folding the backs of her hands together to protect her ears, showing a criss-cross defensive posture, blocking the path of the fist.
The next moment, the girl slid sideways for more than ten steps.
The girl let out a breath of turbid air, stretched out the hand with more blood seeping into the cotton, and straightened the slightly skewed curtain hat on her head.
She was a little angry.
The girl turned around, looked at the tall old man who looked around, and said solemnly: "If it weren't for me, he would be dead."
The old man ignored it, but compared to before, this old eunuch, who was experienced in assassinations and sneak attacks, had reduced the girl's danger level to the second place, and the first place had been given to the person on the other side of the alley.
Of course, apart from the master and the servant, there are only two real outsiders in the alley.
Over there in the alley stood a tall, thin, masked man.
The arms are extremely thick, with bulging muscles like iron balls.
There were two bags hanging from his waist, filled with round objects.
He just stood there, as if to say that the previous sneak attack was actually just a reminder.
When the cold gaze passed over the girl.
The man grinned and stuck out his tongue, his eyes burning.
The girl chuckled and said two words.
"Come back!"
The words just fell.
A sword over the head.
The flying sword came to the girl's side and quickly spun around her, like a child acting like a baby.
She said angrily: "Get out!"
The flying sword flashed away.
The master and servant were dumbfounded.
The old eunuch was not shocked by this flying sword skill.
Instead, he felt sincere fear that the girl could control the flying sword at will here.
This feeling made the old man feel in a trance, as if he had returned to his boyhood. When he first entered the palace, he was trembling with fear. One day, he looked at the man in a red python costume from a distance.Seniors walking under the palace wall.
Of course, it was not in awe of the eunuch himself who didn't even know his name, but in fear of the dazzling scarlet.
After the boy in brocade came back to his senses, he smiled, full of self-mockery, took a step forward, and asked with concern: "Grandpa Wu, are you okay?"
The white-haired old eunuch had a heavy face and shook his head: "It's better to be careful. If it doesn't work, our family will..."
The young man quickly waved his hand and asked, "How about we apologize?"
The old man was caught off guard, and then became sad, angry and self-blame.
The Lord humiliates his ministers to death.
Especially the emperor’s family!
But the young man in brocade clothes had already smiled and said: "Grandpa Wu, you have done something wrong. Why don't you say sorry?"
The old man still felt that this move was inappropriate, and the boy in brocade clothes had already walked towards the girl.
In an instant, the old man had mixed feelings.
It turned out that there was no trace of mud on the boy's back.
